info.title: Prompt API
info.description:
## What are prompts?

Prompt is used to deliver and experience where
users will be given various prompts to agree, or consent
to when using your application or service.

## What can you do with the Prompt API?

* Check and verify a user has consented to various scopes.
* Get UX json documents for displaying consent / agreements to users
